fusions.name: Thorn Larder
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. You dive on it from up to 6 tiles: the strike deals 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stoop Through the Flock
fusions.desc: You dive up to 8 tiles onto the target. The landing deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you.

fusions.name: Shrike on Watch
fusions.desc: Looses a shrike for 12 seconds. It deals 3 damage to an enemy within 4 tiles every second, each pass with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plummeting Beak
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover raises your critical hit chance by 20% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
